title: Police and deputy sheriffs: overtime worth about half their regular pay

beats.text: How much overtime do the City’s police officers and deputy sheriffs earn?
About half their regular pay.
In fiscal 2026: 47.1 percent for the police officers’ unit. 50 percent for the deputies’.
The police officers’ unit alone: 156.8 million dollars.

visual.label: overtime, police officers’ unit, fiscal 2026
visual.sub: plus $47.8 million for the deputies’ unit

beats.text: This is a lead, not a finding.

visual.line: This is a lead, not a finding: a pattern in public records. This film says what the records show, what they do not show, and what would settle it.

beats.text: The first lead. That’s 2.57 times fiscal 2019,

visual.kicker: Overtime, police officers’ unit, fiscal 2014 to 2026

beats.text: and 5.66 times fiscal 2014.
In 2015 it was 14.3 percent, fourth of 7 large California cities.
The second lead: the deputies. 47.8 million dollars in fiscal 2026.
The third lead is an official finding.

beats.text: In December 2024, the Budget and Legislative Analyst audited police overtime.

beats.text: And the department had not adhered to key sick-leave terms of its own agreement.
